name: adapt_renamed_symbol_csharp_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time Area.cs's own text contains 'CircleArea' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt), then MathUtils.Square is RENAMED to MathUtils.Sq under it
prompts: MathUtils.cs declares a public static class MathUtils with a static method Square(double x). Create Area.cs with a public static class Area containing a static method CircleArea(double r) that returns 3.14159 * MathUtils.Square(r).
MathUtils.Square has just been renamed to MathUtils.Sq. Update Area.cs to use the new name (do not keep a reference to the old name Square).

disruptions.description: MathUtils.Square renamed to MathUtils.Sq, triggered reactively once Area.cs's first draft appeared
